origin: Two Hermes researchers plus independent Hermes review; coordinator reconciled candidates. Original review required changes. This integrated proposal has not received a second independent review.
hypothesis: A joint depth/volume feature group improves fixed-horizon quote-share forecasts beyond matched price-only, no-change and momentum baselines.
interpretation: Synthetic price-share forecasting only. Joint-group improvement cannot attribute causality or separate depth from volume and establishes no executable trading edge.

population.venues: all venues in a frozen outcome-blind consecutive inventory
population.scope_reason: Adopt independent reviewer scope for one coherent experiment; no claim Ireland is more profitable than UK. Corpus changes require a new registration before scoring.

temporal_contract.snapshots: backward at or before each cutoff; deterministic file order for equal pt
temporal_contract.eligibility: Complete native field IDs; valid two-sided quote states and required volume; unchanged field and uninterrupted OPEN/pre-play throughout lookback; no schedule revision known by decision. Never re-anchor an issued forecast.
temporal_contract.freshness_note: Quote-change age is a feature, not proof of staleness. Continuity and age gates must be calibrated and frozen before test access.

target.valid_quotes: Both decimal odds > 1; best_back <= best_lay; finite positive available size at both sides; complete then-known active field
target.meaning: Not a calibrated winning probability or executable midpoint price.

P: own q changes over 30, 60 and 180 seconds
features.volume_semantics: Unsigned cumulative matched activity, not buying pressure; validate currency/counters/images/corrections. Missing is not zero. Unreconciled negative increments invalidate the decision window.
features.forbidden_search: No additional horizons, features, models, country/package variants, outcome-based subgroups or rescue candidate on this test.

model.objective: Race-weighted mean squared target loss plus lambda times squared non-intercept coefficients; unpenalized intercept
model.weights: Each market total weight equal; its runner rows divide that weight equally
model.preprocessing: Weighted standardization learned within training folds only; zero-variance features assigned scale 1
model.selection: Chronological validation race-balanced MAE after simplex projection; ties choose larger penalty
model.forecast: Euclidean projection of q(t)+predicted_change onto the simplex

trial_budget.ledger: Record every variant, failure and earlier exploration. Six configurations per fold is not six independent hypotheses. No interim final-test scoring.

label_accounting.preserve: Every issued forecast and its decision-known runner set
label_accounting.undefined_target: Field change before the label changes the same-field target domain; report separately and never remove individual runners retrospectively
label_accounting.other_label_invalidation: Post-decision suspension/in-play/status break recorded separately; keep forecast in issuance cohort
label_accounting.unavailable_but_well_defined: No valid label quote despite established unchanged field/status; distinguish from unknown domain or unknown status
label_accounting.missingness_sensitivity: Only bound losses for well-defined missing targets on the feasible simplex, retaining coupling among runners. Unknown/undefined domains are coverage limitations, not invented outcomes.
label_accounting.report: Full decision cohort, all exclusions and label categories by day/meeting; identical scored cohort for every model; claims conditional on label eligibility

evaluation.primary_metric: Per-market mean absolute error, then equal-weight mean over markets
evaluation.chronology: Early separate audit/precision calibration block, expanding fit/validation folds, then one sealed later test; purge overlapping feature/label intervals and freeze any availability gap
evaluation.margin_rule: Set positive research-usefulness fraction r before candidate comparisons; delta=r*calibration_no_change_MAE. Parser errors invalidate evaluation rather than inflate delta.

uncertainty.method: Stationary bootstrap over consecutive calendar-day blocks, preserving all meetings and paired model losses; recompute equal-market statistic for each resample
uncertainty.multiplicity: Bonferroni across three fixed baseline contrasts; two-sided individual intervals at 1-0.05/3
uncertainty.assumptions: Dependence/stationarity approximations require pilot assessment; too few blocks or achieved precision worse than registered requirement can be inconclusive.

evaluation.precision_plan: Choose fixed test duration from earlier paired day-block variance to target interval half-width <= delta/2; freeze before test access; this does not guarantee precision.
evaluation.robustness: Report leave-day/meeting-out influence as diagnostics; no deletion of adverse groups or extra significance claims.

gates.promote_forecast_research: All three simultaneous lower bounds exceed delta, registered coverage/sensitivity gates pass, and replay/chronology are valid.
gates.reject_useful_increment: At least one required contrast has upper bound <= delta; reject useful improvement for this frozen specification.
gates.inconclusive: Intervals overlap delta, achieved precision is inadequate, or coverage prevents a general conclusion without a demonstrated parser/leakage error.
gates.invalid: Leakage, unresolved replay/identity/counter errors, holdout reuse, or undeclared changes invalidate the evaluation.
gates.economic_gate: A separate future execution simulation requires quotes/depth, delays, conservative queues/fills, exits, impact and applicable fees; no LTP/midpoint profit accounting.

next_implementation: Reconstruct ADV level-keyed back/lay prices and sizes, runner cumulative volume and state resets.
Validate images, conflicting level updates, zero deletion, equal-pt ordering, corrections, suspensions and future-data invariance on engineering data.
Obtain permitted consecutive inventory and freeze a complete calibration/training/validation/test plan before opening final outcomes.
Fit only registered configurations, freeze code/config/data hashes, evaluate the sealed test once and report every gate.
required_before_registration: Positive usefulness margin and dependence/precision calibration
